verdict.rationale: Flagright documents case statuses that map to review and escalation stages (IN_REVIEW, ESCALATED, IN_PROGRESS, ON_HOLD, plus custom status IDs), alert-level ESCALATED status, a case-status update endpoint, and marketing claims for case management and a Workflow Builder for investigation flows. The evidence never shows assigning cases to analysts, and the routing workflow is described only at marketing level. missing for 10: documented case assignment/reassignment to analysts, detailed docs on configuring review-to-escalation routing in the Workflow Builder, independent or hands-on corroboration.
